desc:
🌟 Welcome to Anime Ragdoll! 🌟

Choose your fighter, use powerful moves and send ragdolls flying across the map! Every fighter has their own style and abilities.

⭐ WHAT YOU CAN DO ⭐
🥊 Unlock new fighters by getting knockouts
⚡ Unlock special moves and combos as you play
🧸 Build fun setups in the sandbox
🎁 Come back daily for streak rewards
🛒 Unlock tools, gear and cosmetics
🎮 Play on PC, mobile and console

👥 Invite up to two friends to your server and play together!

🚧 This game is in Early Testing, so new fighters and updates are on the way. 🌍 Public servers are coming in a future update.

👍 Like and ⭐ Favorite so you don’t miss new updates!
